mode: forward inference only; no input mutation

inputs.weight: contiguous CUDA tensor [H]; direct multiplicative gamma

dimensions: positive M and H; no broadcasting of residual
device_and_dtype: all inputs share the same CUDA device and dtype
eps_rule: positive finite Python number added inside the square root
steps: Add x and residual after promoting each to float32
Round their sum to the input dtype; this is residual_out
Compute the mean of squared values along H using float32
Multiply by rsqrt(mean_square + eps) and then float32(weight)
Round the normalized result to the input dtype; this is output
outputs: (output, residual_out); both contiguous [M,H], same dtype/device as x, fresh storage
numerical_domain: finite inputs with no overflow in rounded sum, float32 square/reduction, or output; subnormal behavior is not guaranteed
residual_comparison: exact equality for finite values in the supported numerical domain
comparison_rule: abs(actual-expected) <= atol + rtol*abs(expected) for every output element; all outputs must be finite
baseline_rule: same inputs, rounding boundary, two returned outputs, inference mode, and timing scope for eager PyTorch, torch.compile, and Triton
